study_identification_part.si_4_title: Dynamic gray matter volume changes in pediatric multiple sclerosis

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Linear mixed-effects model fitted voxel-wise to estimate normative GM growth curves in healthy controls.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: the following linear mixed-effects model was fitted voxel-wise to HC preprocessed GM maps

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Gray matter amount/volume at the voxel level from preprocessed GM maps.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: Yij represents the GM amount at voxel level

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Predictors include mean-centered age, sex, and a binary variable accounting for magnetic field strength and acquisition protocol differences.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: Ageij the mean-centered age, Sexi the sex (binary variable) of participant i at time point j. Another binary variable to account for differences in magnetic field strength (MFSi) and acquisition protocol was also added
